summary_zh: 为 AI 代理提供计算机操作能力的命令行工具：通过操作系统辅助功能树读取桌面应用界面并以 JSON 返回可操作元素引用，代理据此点击、输入并再次读取验证；不含内置模型，提供 CLI 与 C 库。
audience_zh: 需要让 AI 代理在 macOS、Windows 或 Linux 上无截图地观察并操作桌面应用的开发者；适合自行编写代理循环、需要 CLI 或进程内 C 库集成，并自行处理私密桌面内容的团队。

evidence.quote: Computer use CLI for AI agents
Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.

agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The
loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library.
